declarations.name: payment_domain.Plan.readsA
declarations.signature: payment_domain.Principal → payment_domain.Command → Option (List (H5iAppLib.Query.Read payment_domain.Schema.Val))
declarations.definition:
fun a x =>
  match x with
  | payment_domain.Command.Create a_1 a_2 a_3 =>
    some [{ table := 4, pred := H5iAppLib.Query.Pred.all }, { table := 5, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 a.user }]
  | payment_domain.Command.BeginAuthorize id => some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id }]
  | payment_domain.Command.Cancel id => some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id }]
  | payment_domain.Command.RequestRefund p a =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }, { table := 4, pred := H5iAppLib.Query.Pred.all }]
  | payment_domain.Command.Record p r =>
    some ({ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p } :: payment_domain.Plan.resultA r)
  | payment_domain.Command.Event e p r =>
    some
      ({ table := 2, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 e } ::
        { table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p } :: payment_domain.Plan.resultA r)
  | payment_domain.Command.AttachRef p a =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }, { table := 3, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }]
  | payment_domain.Command.Get id => some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id }]
  | payment_domain.Command.List m f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 64 ∧ (a.operator = true ∨ m = a.user) then
      some (payment_domain.Plan.pageA m (↑f) (payment_domain.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []
  | payment_domain.Command.GetRefund id =>
    some
      [{ table := 1, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id },
        { table := 0, pred := H5iAppLib.Query.Pred.isIn 0 1 (payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id) 1 { } }]
  | payment_domain.Command.Refunds p =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }, { table := 1, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 1 p }]
  | payment_domain.Command.GetRef p =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }, { table := 3, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }]
  | payment_domain.Command.View id =>
    some
      [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id }, { table := 1, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 1 id },
        { table := 3, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 id }]
  | payment_domain.Command.MarkPosted p a a_1 =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 0 p }, { table := 1, pred := payment_domain.Plan.eqU 1 p }]
